title: `ask` NL tool passes the team name as both name and club filter for player questions
evidence: src/main.rs:96 `db.players(team,None,team,None,10)` — a question like "players for Flamengo" filters name=Flamengo AND club=Flamengo, so it returns nothing (no player is named Flamengo)
suggestion: Pass the detected team only as the club filter (name=None) for player-intent questions

title: Dead `_mapping` parameter on load_matches
evidence: src/lib.rs:213 `_mapping: &[(&str, &str)]` is accepted and passed at every call site but never used; loader instead hardcodes column-name fallbacks (home_team/home/Equipe_mandante, etc.)
suggestion: Drop the unused parameter and its per-call literal arrays, or actually drive column resolution from it

title: MCP protocol implemented by hand rather than via an SDK crate
evidence: src/main.rs:108-152 dispatches initialize/tools/list/tools/call/notifications/initialized as raw JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout; no rmcp/mcp SDK dependency in Cargo.toml
suggestion: None required — satisfies R1; noted for cross-run comparison since other stacks may use an SDK

title: All queries are linear scans over in-memory Vecs
evidence: src/lib.rs:333-349,484-499 iterate the full ~24k-match / ~18k-player vectors per query with no index
suggestion: Acceptable at this data size (well within the spec's <2s/<5s targets); an index would matter only at larger scale
